name: Indegene Ltd
title: Indegene Ltd - 544172 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Indegene is a life-sciences commercial/medical outsourcing services firm, not supply-capacity driven; Q4 revenue crossed ₹1,000 crore (up 32.8% YoY) but management gave no formal FY27 revenue guidance and margin recovery rests on investment payback.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue ₹1,000 crore+, up 32.8% YoY
triggers.quote: growing 6.5% quarter-on-quarter and a strong 32.8% year-over-year

triggers.label: No formal FY27 revenue guidance
triggers.quote: we're not providing formal revenue guidance

triggers.label: Tectonic win with largest customer
triggers.quote: We won a significant Tectonic engagement starting with Germany
triggers.highlight: We won a significant Tectonic engagement

triggers.label: Margin recovery pushed to H2 FY27
triggers.quote: the second half of FY27 will see us revert to the earlier levels of higher margins
triggers.highlight: second half of FY27 will see us revert

guidance.value: Margin recovery to earlier levels in H2 FY27
guidance.quote: the second half of FY27 will see us revert to the earlier levels of higher margins
we're not providing formal revenue guidance
I would guide towards mid-60s to 70 days on a steady basis

red_flags.label: Exceptional US TCPA class action provision ₹203 million
red_flags.quote: we have provided ₹203 million towards the estimated cost of settling the U.S. class action lawsuit

red_flags.label: Adjusted EBITDA excludes ₹241m forex hedge charge via retroactive hedge accounting
red_flags.quote: the adjustment to the EBITDA is made to reflect the impact on profitability if the contracts that were contracted between April 2025 and December 2025 were also considered as cash flow hedges

red_flags.label: Margin investment shelved recovery timing
red_flags.quote: the investments that we made, resulting in 150 basis points impact on our EBITDA margins
